# hetznerrobot_server_cancellation (Resource)

Cancels a dedicated server. **A server cancelled `now` is gone immediately, with all its data** — prefer a date. Destroying this resource withdraws a pending cancellation; once the date has passed there is nothing left to withdraw, and the resource stays in state as the record of it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_server_cancellation" "old" {
  server_number = 421
}

# Cancels the server to its earliest possible date. Destroying this resource
# withdraws the cancellation again, as long as the date has not passed.
resource "hetznerrobot_server_cancellation" "old" {
  server_number       = 421
  cancellation_date   = data.hetznerrobot_server_cancellation.old.earliest_cancellation_date
  cancellation_reason = "Upgrade to a new server"
  reserve_location    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cancellation_date` (String) Date the server should be cancelled to (`yyyy-MM-dd`), or `now` to cancel immediately. See `earliest_cancellation_date` of the data source for the earliest possible date.
- `server_number` (Number) Server number.

### Optional

- `cancellation_reason` (String) Reason for the cancellation — one of the `cancellation_reasons` of the `hetznerrobot_server_cancellation` data source. Changing it forces a new cancellation; setting or removing it does not.
- `reserve_location` (Boolean) Whether the server's location should be reserved after the cancellation. Robot requires it when `reservation_possible` is true and only accepts `false` otherwise. Changing it forces a new cancellation; setting or removing it does not.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the cancellation is active.
- `earliest_cancellation_date` (String) Earliest possible cancellation date.
- `effective_date` (String) Cancellation date as Robot holds it — the actual date for `now`.
- `reservation_possible` (Boolean) Whether the location can be reserved.
- `reserved` (Boolean) Whether the location will be reserved after the cancellation.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server.
- `server_name` (String) Name of the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_server_cancellation.old 421
```
